results.name: Barbell Hang Clean
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, bend at your hips and knees to grip the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Hold the barbell against your thighs.

Begin the exercise by hinging at the hips, lowering the barbell to knee level, then explosively extend your hips and knees, lightly jumping, while shrugging your shoulders and pulling the barbell up to your chest level.
Swiftly rotate your elbows underneath the bar and catch it across the front of your shoulders in a partial squat.
Lower the barbell back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep the barbell close to your body throughout the entire movement.
Generate power from your hips and legs rather than pulling with your arms, landing on soft knees during the catch.
Engage your core to support your lower back and maintain stability throughout the movement.
Exhale during the explosive pull and inhale as you reset for the next repetition.
results.description: Barbell Hang Clean is an advanced multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Quadriceps, Hamstrings.

results.name: Barbell Muscle Clean
instructions: Begin in a squatted position with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell with an overhand grip (palms facing your body), hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. The barbell should be resting on the floor.

Explosively extend your hips and knees while pulling the barbell up towards your chest, keeping it close to your body. As the barbell passes your knees, shrug your shoulders and continue to pull the barbell upward.
Quickly rotate your elbows under the bar and catch it in a front rack position with your elbows pointing forward. Stand up straight to complete the lift.
Lower the barbell back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep the barbell close to your body to ensure an efficient and powerful lift.
Focus on an explosive hip extension to generate the necessary force for the clean.
Engage your shoulders and traps during the shrug to assist in lifting the barbell.
Use your legs and hips rather than relying solely on your arms to lift the barbell.
results.description: Barbell Muscle Clean is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms, Biceps.

results.name: Barbell Press Under
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and hold the barbell across the back of your shoulders with a wide grip.
Press the barbell overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Lower your body into a squat while keeping the barbell locked out overhead, pause for 1-2 seconds.
Return to the starting position by pressing through your heels. Reset and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your arms fully extended while the barbell is overhead.
Keep your chest up and your core engaged throughout the movement for stability.
Keep your heels flat on the floor throughout the squat.
Inhale deeply before moving into the squat and exhale as you stand back up.
results.description: Barbell Press Under is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Hamstrings, Core.

results.name: Plate Clean and Press
instructions: Grip a weight plate on the floor and hinge at your hips.
Drive your hips forward to clean the plate up to your chest.
Press the plate straight overhead until your arms are locked out.
Lower it to your chest, then to the floor, and repeat.
tips: Brace your core before the press.
Keep your back flat when lowering.
results.description: Plate Clean and Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Triceps, Traps.

results.name: Plate Clean
instructions: Stand with a weight plate on the floor in front of you and grip it by its sides.
Hinge at your hips with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward explosively and pull the plate up.
Catch it at your chest with your elbows under it, then lower and repeat.
tips: The power comes from your hips, not your arms.
Keep the plate close to your body.
results.description: Plate Clean is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Traps, Shoulders, Quadriceps.

results.name: Plate Thruster
instructions: Hold a weight plate at your chest.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive up explosively and press the plate overhead in one movement.
Lower the plate to your chest as you go into the next squat.
tips: Use the momentum from your legs to help the press.
Keep your heels down in the squat.
results.description: Plate Thruster is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Triceps, Core.

results.name: Sandbag Cleans
instructions: Stand over a sandbag with your feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at your hips and grab the sandbag by its sides or handles.
Drive your hips forward explosively and pull the bag up to your chest.
Catch it close to your body, lower it and repeat.
tips: Keep your back flat at the start.
Pull the bag up close to your body.
results.description: Sandbag Cleans is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Traps, Biceps, Core.

results.name: Arm Tuck Side Bend
instructions: Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart, with your right arm extended straight out to the side at shoulder height and palm facing upwards and your left hand resting on your hip.
Bend your right arm at the elbow, bringing your hand down towards your lower back.
Return your right arm to the extended position.
Continue the movement with the same arm for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on keeping your shoulder relaxed to avoid tension in your neck and upper back.
Maintain a steady rhythm to ensure consistent movement and effective muscle engagement.
Use a mirror, if available, to check your form.
results.description: Arm Tuck Side Bend is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Backhand Raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees bent and lean forward at the hips until your torso is halfway parallel to the floor. Keep your back straight.
Extend your arms straight back parallel to your torso with your palms facing backwards.
Raise your arms upwards, keeping them straight, until they are over your back.
Lower your arms back to the starting position in a controlled manner.
tips: Engage your core to maintain stability and support your lower back throughout the exercise.
Keep your movements slow and controlled to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
Focus on squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement to enhance upper back activation.
results.description: Backhand Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Back, Arms.

results.name: Band Behind Neck Shoulder Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the resistance band under your feet. Hold one handle of the band in each hand and bring them up to shoulder height with the band extending behind your body.
Press the handles upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Slowly lower the handles back to shoulder height with control, maintaining tension in the band.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure the resistance band is securely placed under your feet to avoid slipping.
Exhale as you press the band overhead and inhale as you lower it back down.
Perform the exercise slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement.
results.description: Band Behind Neck Shoulder Press is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Upper Back.
